headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Result Update| Sector: Auto Ancillary SBICAP Securities Limited | 2 Key highlights of the 2QFY27 Result Strong operational performance driven by robust growth in the PV business and exports During 2QFY27, the company reported a 16.9%/22.0%/34.8% YoY increase in Revenue/EBITDA/Adj.
The company witnessed a steady 21.7% YoY growth in the automotive business compared to 17.8% YoY growth in the automotive industry (2W+PV) production volumes.
This performance was primarily driven by 33.4% YoY growth in the passenger vehicle (PV) segment and 23.1% YoY growth in exports.
FY27 Outlook: During 2QFY27, the management explicitly characterized the sales moderation as a deliberate strategic recalibration rather than a demand slowdown.
valuation: At the CMP of Rs 2,029, the stock is currently trading at a P/E of 30.1x/24.1x of its FY27E/FY28E EPS of Rs 67.1/Rs 83.8 respectively.
We value the stock at P/E of 32x FY28E EPS of Rs 83.8 to arrive at our TP of Rs 2,681, thus providing an upside potential of 32.1%.
